heading.en: What is a newton really made of?

hook.en: Every physical quantity, however complicated, is built from mass, length, time and a few more. Its *dimensions* tell us the recipe.
hook.kn: ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣವಾದ ಭೌತ ಪರಿಮಾಣವಾದರೂ ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ, ಉದ್ದ, ಕಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೂ ಕೆಲವು ಮೂಲ ಪರಿಮಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಅದರ ಆಯಾಮಗಳು ಆ ರಚನೆಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Every physical quantity, however complicated, is built from mass, length, time and a few more. Its dimensions tell us the recipe.
say.kn: ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣವಾದ ಭೌತ ಪರಿಮಾಣವಾದರೂ ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ, ಉದ್ದ, ಕಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೂ ಕೆಲವು ಮೂಲ ಪರಿಮಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಅದರ ಆಯಾಮಗಳು ಆ ರಚನೆಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: The *dimensions* of a quantity are the powers to which the base quantities must be raised to represent it. We write them in square brackets: [M] for mass, [L] for length, [T] for time, [A] for current and [K] for temperature. Velocity is $[M^0 L T^{-1}]$ and force is $[M L T^{-2}]$.
body.kn: ಒಂದು ಭೌತ ಪರಿಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸಲು ಮೂಲ ಪರಿಮಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಏರಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಘಾತಗಳೇ ಅದರ ಆಯಾಮಗಳು. ವೇಗದ ಆಯಾಮ [M⁰ L T⁻¹], ಬಲದ ಆಯಾಮ [M L T⁻²].

say.en: The dimensions of a quantity are the powers to which the base quantities must be raised to represent it. We write them in square brackets: [M] for mass, [L] for length, [T] for time, [A] for current and [K] for temperature. Velocity is [M to the power 0 L T to the power minus 1 ] and force is [M L T to the power minus 2 ]. Area [L squared], volume [L cubed], density [ML to the power minus 3].
say.kn: ಒಂದು ಭೌತ ಪರಿಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸಲು ಮೂಲ ಪರಿಮಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಏರಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಘಾತಗಳೇ ಅದರ ಆಯಾಮಗಳು. ವೇಗದ ಆಯಾಮ [M to the power 0 L T to the power minus 1], ಬಲದ ಆಯಾಮ [M L T to the power minus 2].

say.en: Acceleration [LT to the power minus 2], momentum [MLT to the power minus 1].
Pure numbers, angles and ratios such as strain are dimensionless.

title.en: Find the pendulum formula by dimensions

narration.en: Suppose the period of a pendulum is T = k mᵃ lᵇ gᶜ. The dimensions of the right side are [Mᵃ Lᵇ⁺ᶜ T⁻²ᶜ], and they must equal [T]. Move the powers until the bars match the target: a = 0, b + c = 0 and −2c = 1, so T = k√(l/g). The method cannot find k (it is 2π).
narration.kn: ಲೋಲಕದ ಆವರ್ತಕಾಲ T = k mᵃ lᵇ gᶜ ಎಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಬಲಭಾಗದ ಆಯಾಮಗಳು [Mᵃ Lᵇ⁺ᶜ T⁻²ᶜ], ಅವು [T] ಗೆ ಸಮವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು. ಗುರಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದುವವರೆಗೆ ಘಾತಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿ: a = 0, b + c = 0, −2c = 1, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ T = k√(l/g). ಈ ವಿಧಾನ k ಅನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಲಾರದು (ಅದು 2π).

The dimensions of the right side are [M to the power a L to the power b to the power plus c T to the power minus 2c], and they must equal [T]. say.en: Start from the base quantities: mass M, length L and time T.
Acceleration is velocity per time, and force is mass times acceleration.
Work is force times distance. Power is work per second.
Pressure is force per area, so it loses two powers of length.
For G, rearrange Newton's law: G equals F r squared over m one m two.

explanation.en: Write the quantity in terms of mass, length and time and read off the powers. Force = mass × acceleration gives [M L T⁻²]; work = force × distance gives [M L² T⁻²]; power = work/time gives [M L² T⁻³]; pressure = force/area gives [M L⁻¹ T⁻²]; G = F r²/(m₁m₂) gives [M⁻¹ L³ T⁻²].
explanation.kn: ಪರಿಮಾಣವನ್ನು ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ, ಉದ್ದ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದು ಘಾತಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ. ಬಲ = ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ × ವೇಗೋತ್ಕರ್ಷ → [M L T⁻²]; ಕೆಲಸ = ಬಲ × ದೂರ → [M L² T⁻²]; ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ = ಕೆಲಸ/ಸಮಯ → [M L² T⁻³]; ಒತ್ತಡ = ಬಲ/ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ → [M L⁻¹ T⁻²]; G = F r²/(m₁m₂) → [M⁻¹ L³ T⁻²].

say.en: How do we use this in a *problem*?

Work and energy: [ML squared T to the power minus 2 ]. Power: [ML squared T to the power minus 3 ]. Pressure and stress: [ML to the power minus 1 T to the power minus 2 ]. Gravitational constant G: [M to the power minus 1 L cubed T to the power minus 2 ]. Planck's constant and angular momentum share [ML squared T to the power minus 1 ]. Same dimensions: work, energy, torque.
say.kn: ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿ [ML squaredT to the power minus 2], ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ [ML squaredT to the power minus 3], ಒತ್ತಡ [ML to the power minus 1T to the power minus 2], G ಯ ಆಯಾಮ [M to the power minus 1L cubedT to the power minus 2]. ಪ್ಲಾಂಕ್ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಕೋನೀಯ ಸಂವೇಗಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದೇ ಆಯಾಮ [ML squaredT to the power minus 1].

problem.en: Find the dimensional formula of G from F = G m₁m₂ / r².

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the dimensional formula of G from F = G m₁m₂ / r².

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the dimensional formula of G from F equals G m 1m 2 divided by r squared.
G equals F r squared / m 1 m 2.
[G] = [MLT to the power minus 2][L squared] / [M squared].
[G] = [M to the power minus 1 L cubed T to the power minus 2].
So the answer is [M to the power minus 1 L cubed T to the power minus 2].

problem.en: Find the dimensional formula of power.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the dimensional formula of power.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the dimensional formula of power.
Power equals work divided by time.
[Power] = [ML squaredT to the power minus 2] / [T] = [ML squaredT to the power minus 3].
So the answer is [ML squaredT to the power minus 3].

body.en: Remember force = [MLT⁻²]. Then work = force × length, pressure = force / area, power = work / time and impulse = force × time. You never need to memorise the rest.
